failure_patterns.pattern: first_search_hygiene: A first single-domain search was written as a bare search_*() with no assignment or save, one with a stray </parameter> tag (restaurant and attraction first turns).

rejected_edits.content: . Earlier turns are already inside the cached entry: never re-pass an earlier cuisine, dietary flag, stars, neighborhood, amenity, budget, class or party size. Party size (num_people) exists only on hotel tools, never on restaurant or flight calls.
rejected_edits.target: , plus any earlier-stated constraint that the CACHE summary text ("Additionally filtering for ..." / search description) does not show as applied.

rejected_edits.content: - Hotels AND attractions keys both cached, the assistant just offered hotels near that attraction, and the user answers with hotel constraints (amenities, stars, budget): load the most refined hotels key, `filter_hotels(prior_results=h, <only the last message's kwargs>)`, save it, then `search_nearest(hotels=<filtered result>, attractions=<loaded attractions key>, groupBy="hotel")` saved as nearest_hotels. No new attraction search, and do not re-save the attractions key.
rejected_edits.target: - Without a hotels key, 'near the hotel' needs no search_nearest. Just run the normal first search.
